instrument: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 Art. 39 - evasion of FX control (逃汇)
trigger: Transferring FX or capital out of China in breach of the rules, including by deception
notes: Plus an order to repatriate the FX; criminal liability in serious cases

instrument: Art. 40 - illegal purchase of FX with false or invalid documents (非法套汇)
trigger: Buying FX at a bank with false or invalid transaction documents
notes: The money is converted back; the fine is on top

instrument: Art. 42 - carrying FX across the border in breach of the rules
trigger: Carrying out more than the permitted amount without the permit

instrument: Art. 45 - private dealing in FX, money changers, underground banks
trigger: Private buying and selling of FX, or brokering it
rate: Warning, confiscation of gains, up to 30%; serious cases 30% to 100%

instrument: No penalty found for a lawful documented conversion
trigger: A conversion under M01, M02, M04, M05, M06 or M07 with genuine documents
notes: No official source read in this pass imposes a tax or a penalty on the conversion itself. The bank cost is a price, not a penalty.

instrument: Individual income tax on the income behind the balance (if unpaid)
trigger: Income earned in China on which IIT was not withheld or paid
amount_basis: Percent of the income, by category
rate: 3%-45% progressive on comprehensive income; 20% proportional on the listed categories
notes: NOT re-read this session - inherited register row; shown so it is not mistaken for a conversion tax

instrument: 26 U.S.C. 988 + IRS Pub. 525 - tax on the currency gain itself
trigger: Disposing of RMB for USD at a different rate from the acquisition
amount_basis: Percent of the GAIN, not of the amount
rate: 15% long-term capital (middle bracket) or 20% (top); possibly ordinary at up to 37%
notes: Computed for every amount and every acquisition year in data/c348_tax.csv

trigger: Failing to file an FBAR that was due
notes: This is a filing penalty, not a tax

amount_basis: Greater of a fixed figure or half the balance
rate: USD 165,353 or 50% of the account balance
notes: The 50% prong is the one that scales with the balance

instrument: CBP / 31 U.S.C. 5316 - unreported cash over USD 10,000
trigger: Bringing in or sending out more than USD 10,000 in currency without FinCEN Form 105
amount_basis: Seizure and forfeiture; civil or criminal penalties
notes: Applies per family or group collectively

trigger: Converting RMB to crypto or stablecoin inside China
rate: Strictly prohibited and suppressed; losses are the investor's own
